description: Observed Engine differences from the portable corpus. Entries may only be removed as their guarantees are implemented; the exit test pins the ceiling.

entries.reason: A revision publishes without the developer round marker required by the round sequence.
Repeated red gates exhaust the Flow revision counter instead of recording a repeat_failure pause.
Under-reported objectives fail validation without a fresh retry or durable infrastructure pause.
A missing reviewer result ends the run after one attempt, without a retry or pause record.
The policy reader throws during task-input preparation before the Flow starts, refusing entry without a durable infrastructure pause or escalation record.
Unknown addressed finding ids are accepted and the next reviewed round publishes; the turn acceptance gap also concerns INV-031.
A failed provider step ends the run without recording or spending the infrastructure retry.
A claimed required source with no delivery receipt is accepted and reaches review and publication.
Red gates bypass the task time budget assessment and exhaust the Flow revision counter.
The round cap is assessed but its pause has no durable state or pause comment.
An escalation decision has no durable pause or escalation record, handoff event or pause comment.
Re-entering the runner after a ruling starts a new leg without consuming a durable resolution or emitting resumed.
The runner halt handle pauses; it neither consumes a cancel resolution nor records cancellation.
The halt handle accepts a request without authenticating a Principal ruling and has no durable pause resolution.
Changed objectives fail verdict rendering rather than producing the typed objectives_changed pause.
A conflicting forge head reaches reviewers and publication.
merged_ready is emitted before the publication callback fails, with no durable crash pause.
Re-entry after a publication crash dispatches the developer again and emits merged_ready for both legs.
A refused publication on the wrong branch still reaches reviewers and final publication.
